zones.description: waiting zone: the approach lanes just before the stop line (camera looks along the road; cars come toward the camera)

lines.description: stop line across the approach lanes; cars travel from top to bottom of the frame

rule_text: Every car must wait at least 1.5 seconds in the waiting zone before it crosses the stop line.
